acceptance_criteria: plain codex resume is the only canonical automatic transport for the Herdr binding
no tmux keystroke or Herdr prompt path is invoked
the old tmux authority cannot coexist with a valid authoritative Herdr binding
delivery confirmation and frontend cleanup are deterministic and durable
human composer state is never inspected through terminal scraping or mutated by Opsle
busy and uncertainty do not cause blind replay
event evaluation remains idempotent and generation-fenced
pause-after-current preserves current evaluation before PAUSED
focused and full verification pass with no unexpected files

may: inspect installed Codex source and rollout record shapes read-only
modify repository source, CLI, tests, and documentation
add repository-local scripts for deterministic resume delivery
run focused and full deterministic verification
may_not: modify sibling repositories, global Codex configuration, or Herdr configuration
use codex exec resume, tmux send-keys, Herdr agent.prompt, terminal input, or raw child output in wake messages
clear, overwrite, submit, or otherwise mutate a human draft
use arbitrary sleep or model polling as delivery confirmation
weaken authority, generation, dispatcher, event, lease, rollout, or process fences
push, merge, deploy, install server-wide, or initialize another repository

expected_evidence: session binding rejects repository, supervisor, generation, session, rollout, host, and supersession drift
transport argv is exactly codex resume SESSION_ID MESSAGE and is detached into its own process group
delivery is confirmed only from the bound rollout's exact unique message plus turn-began record
confirmed delivery terminates the temporary process group and proves it exited
busy before acceptance remains queued and retry is event-driven
uncertain after possible acceptance is never automatically replayed
duplicate delivery, event consumption, generation mismatch, and stale dispatcher tests pass
pause-after-current applies only after accept or reject
focused tests and npm run verify pass
